prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were mostly too high for neutral or negative changes, but too low for winning tests (sign_in notification and adoption new_flow).
No clear effect was seen for home new_flow changes across 2 tests.
No clear effect was seen for sign_in reorder changes across 2 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect in 2 tests and made performance worse in 2 tests.
Finish new_screen changes made finish worse in 1 test and showed no clear effect in 1 test.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path reorder and sign_in notification (1 test each), while adoption new_flow had mixed results across 2 tests (1 worse, 1 won).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +1.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -4.2% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -2.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -2.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +8.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -1.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 79.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 71.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 22.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Split Screen Companion Overview: Redesign the home_intro screen into a split layout separating companion greeting copy from immediate desktop interaction buttons. (why: Finish stage has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel (64.8%) and a very high mean duration of 5815s. A clear split screen structure reduces ambiguity at the final step.)
1: [home, new_screen] Companion Initialization Status Screen: Insert a dedicated initialization status screen before waiting to provide visual system checks prior to companion desktop loading. (why: Home phase duration averages 2336s, and support reported instances of pet not rendering on desktop (3 emails). Transparent loading feedback keeps users engaged while assets initialize.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Trait & Persona Match Flow: Introduce a stage layout with interactive persona matching cards within the pet selection phase to guide companion choice. (why: Adoption stage conversion dropped to 71.7% with median 89s and mean 1017s. Structuring choices via personality traits helps undecided users choose faster.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Deferred to Adoption Completion: Move sign-in screen to take place after adoption certificate creation right before waiting. (why: Sign-in early in onboarding has a mean duration of 567s. Moving authentication after pet adoption lets users build affinity before committing to account registration.)
4: [home, notification] Background Rendering Completion Notification: Enable desktop notification options and time estimation on the waiting screen so users know when companion generation is complete. (why: The waiting step in home has a very long mean time of 2336s, indicating users minimize the app while waiting for pet assets to render.)
5: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Time Estimate Hint: Display explicit duration estimates and explanatory hints on the path selection screen. (why: Choose path has a median duration of 8s but a mean duration of 514s, indicating significant decision latency for hesitant users.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Stage Focus Layout: Switch the choose_path layout to a stage layout to highlight key differences between onboarding paths. (why: 76.2% conversion with a high mean time (514s) shows users get stalled comparing options at the start of onboarding.)
7: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Processing Progress Steps: Add progress indicators and step counters to the upload_photos screen to keep users informed during custom pet uploads. (why: Adoption stage has a mean time of 1017s and 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or stalling.)
